name: Review run card shows severity counters, filters by severity, and offers Accept / Reject
description: HW1 findings criteria. On PR #482's Agent runs tab, the expanded (first) Review run card shows the «N CRITICAL · N WARNING · N SUGGESTION» pills computed from the seeded findings (1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING), the three severity filter buttons, and Accept / Reject on each finding card. Clicking the Warning filter leaves only the N+1 finding visible; clicking it again restores the Stripe-key finding. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic stack, see e2e/README.md).
